submitted_text:
I was home on January 18th working remotely.
No delivery attempt was made to my door - no knock, no doorbell.
I've had packages stolen before, but always from the building entrance.
My unit has a secure enclosed porch where carriers leave packages.
USPS claims delivery to "Front Door" but nothing was left at my front door.

I believe this may be a carrier scan error or misdelivery to wrong address.
